Questions

What does “Online store” cost?
The MVP costs $8,000–16,000 (UZS 96–193 mln), the full version $22,000–55,000 (UZS 260–665 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Online store” take?
The MVP takes 6–10 weeks, the full version 14–24 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Domain and hosting access; Texts, photos and the logo; One person who makes the decisions.
